complete_task.label: Mark Task Complete
complete_task.description: Mark an existing task as completed.

task_id.label: Task ID
task_id.description: The ID of the task to mark as completed. Obtain the id from Find Tasks.

get_task.label: Get Task
get_task.description: Fetch a single task by its ID.

task_id.label: Task ID
task_id.description: The ID of the task to fetch. Obtain the id from Find Tasks.

move_task.label: Move Task
move_task.description: Reposition or reparent a task within its list, or move it to another list.

task_id.label: Task ID
task_id.description: The ID of the task to move. Obtain the id from Find Tasks.

parent_task_id.label: Parent Task ID
parent_task_id.description: Reparent the task under the task with this id (must be in the destination list). Obtain the id from Find Tasks. Omit to move it to the top level.

previous_task_id.label: Previous Task ID
previous_task_id.description: Place the task immediately after the sibling with this id (must be in the destination list). Obtain the id from Find Tasks. Omit to place it first among its siblings; to move it to the end, pass the last sibling's id (read the current order with Find Tasks).

destination_tasklist_id.label: Destination Task List ID
destination_tasklist_id.description: Move the task to this task list. Omit to keep it in the current list. Recurring tasks cannot be moved between lists.
